verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents an official hosted MCP server (mcp.cal.com, or a local instance) that lets users manage bookings, event types, schedules and more through natural language in any MCP-compatible client. Its agents docs describe AI agents checking availability and creating bookings, and the probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface (natural-language control requires an external MCP/AI client), detail on which operations the MCP tools cover, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works well.
